evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative command to erase knowledge asserts control over what the recipient may know, combining coercive insistence with informational gatekeeping.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Direct imperative to purge stored knowledge performs the same coercive-informational erasure pattern as the companion directive.

mints.name: MandateKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: imperative command to forget or remove specified knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker asserting coercive authority over what the recipient is permitted to know, ordering the destruction of held information?
